news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.1% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.24 (vs ₹0.04 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.24 (up from ₹0.04 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹13.7m (down 42% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹3.55m (up 390% from 3Q 2025). news.title: New major risk - Revenue size
news.body: The company makes less than US$1m in revenue. Total revenue: ₹82m (US$919k) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small amount of revenue are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.10 (vs ₹0.29 in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.10 (down from ₹0.29 in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹31.9m (down 28% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.47m (down 66% from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 4.6% (down from 9.7% in 2Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by lower revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 20% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 7% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
